known_escapes.fault: a bound of 0.45 where the class reaches 0.5
known_escapes.why: the panel brackets the bound and does not pin it: any bound inside the bracket returns the known answers. The exact bound has to be derived, and derived again by a second author.

known_escapes.fault: stored-word machines relabelled as another physics
known_escapes.why: the gate reads the physics an organism declares. It cannot read what the organism is.

known_escapes.fault: the register-swap ruler declared shared on three relabelled stored-word machines
known_escapes.why: the gate counts physics by name. Whether three physics are unlike is a judgment, registered in advance and attacked by a second author's isomer.

known_escapes.fault: an observer that disturbs the world only on seeds outside those checked
known_escapes.why: equivalence is shown on the seeds checked and on no others. A run has to be checked on its own seeds.

known_escapes.fault: a carry that native() hides and that is used two episodes later
known_escapes.why: the gate looks one episode ahead and at the state a runtime reports. State hidden from both passes.

known_escapes.fault: an estimator that ran 95% of the registered budget
known_escapes.why: 256 founders resolve an error in reach of a few standard errors and nothing smaller.

known_escapes.fault: the cue follows the second bit of a counter the organism can read
known_escapes.why: the gate runs a list of baselines, not the class. No baseline on the list reads that bit.

known_escapes.fault: run 3's idle sham, with a cell added in which another, harmful operation is called the sham
known_escapes.why: an audit of numbers cannot see what an operation was. The fire test of a sham must use that sham.

known_escapes.fault: the cost definition registered as a sentence that says nothing
known_escapes.why: presence and type are checked, not meaning.

known_escapes.fault: an edited copy of the discovery generator presented as a new family
known_escapes.why: generators are compared by the hash of their code. Whether two generators are one family is a judgment about their grammar.

known_escapes.fault: a facet typed PASS whose named source was never run
known_escapes.why: the gate requires a source and does not open it.
